description: Ground Truth Agent (Bundle 3, ground-truth-agent) — Genie Agent over metric views for operational analytics. Depends on Part A (app deploy) completing first.

waves.name: Bundle config and notebooks
gate: All wave 0 sessions have status done
databricks.yml has genie_spaces.ground_truth_ops resource with file_path
ground_truth_ops.geniespace.json has version 2 format with 6 data sources

sessions.title: Bundle config and Genie Agent resource
sessions.scope: Configure databricks.yml variables, targets, and genie_spaces resource. Create .geniespace.json with data sources, instructions, and sample questions.

sessions.title: Metric view SQL and deploy/verification jobs
sessions.scope: Create deploy_metric_views notebook (reads infra YAML fixtures, executes DDL, adds OTel views), agent_verification notebook, and 2 job resource YAMLs.

waves.name: Converge: deploy agent and verify
gate: Session 03 status is pass with a final attempt classified stable

sessions.title: Deploy agent, create metric views, verify
sessions.scope: Deploy the agent bundle, wait for Lakehouse Sync tables, create metric views (fixing column drift), deploy Genie Agent, run verification until all checks pass.
sessions.context_notes: Depends on Part A (app deploy) completing. Lakehouse Sync tables may take 1-15 minutes after app deploys. Column drift between infra fixtures and actual lb_*_history schemas is expected — fix in-session. OTel tables already exist and can be used immediately. Infra metric view YAML paths: ../../ground-truth-infra/fixtures/metric_views/mv_*.yaml.
